WHAT WE OFFER

Programs For Every Age & Goal

Six programs built to develop the whole student — body, mind, and character — for every age in Rocklin, CA.

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for Kids & Teens

Often called the "gentle art," BJJ teaches students to use leverage and technique over strength — building real self-defense skills, strategic thinking, and unshakable confidence.

Learn More →
Traditional Martial Arts for the 21st Century

Blending Taekwondo, BJJ, Kickboxing, and Krav Maga with timeless values — integrity, perseverance, and self-control — for students ages 5 and up.

Learn More →
Fusion Fun Club After School

More than childcare — a dynamic environment combining martial arts training, homework assistance, and engaging group activities to help kids grow and thrive.

Learn More →
Super Summer Fun Camps

Screen-free summer days packed with martial arts, team games, field trips, and themed experiences that build confidence and create lifelong friendships.

Learn More →
Fusion Elite Homeschool Academy

Enrichment built for homeschool families — martial arts, archery, engineering, and music in a social, hands-on environment that makes learning exciting.

Learn More →
Fusion Music Lessons

Private one-on-one instruction in piano, guitar, and ukulele — building creativity, focus, and the confidence to perform from the very first lesson.

Learn More →
